subject: LinuxReplay reveal() ignores ModuleProgress.complete return value
description: Nancy follow-up from the tourist-visa fix review. LinuxReplay.js:97-102 wraps ModuleProgress.complete, calls reveal() unconditionally and returns r — even when the inner (TouristVisa-wrapped) call returned false because the visa blocked the save. Result: replay button revealed for a completion that did not persist on lab/box pages using LinuxReplay. Same bug class as the ch01 dishonest button. Fix: only reveal() when the wrapped call did not return false.
activeForm: Fixing LinuxReplay reveal on blocked completion
